The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Cohden K'Reye]] composed a '''treatise''' at some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The treatise highlighted several recreation-related locations of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]].
